package customresponse_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	svc "example.com/customresponse/gen/customresponse"
	client "example.com/customresponse/gen/http/customresponse/client"
	server "example.com/customresponse/gen/http/customresponse/server"
	"example.com/customresponse/scalar"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestCustomResponseWire(t *testing.T) {
	for _, location := range []string{"header", "cookie", "projected"} {
		for _, errorResponse := range []bool{false, true} {
			for _, supplied := range []bool{false, true} {
				t.Run(location+caseName(errorResponse, supplied), func(t *testing.T) {
					token := scalar.Token{Text: "abc"}
					defaulted := scalar.Token{Text: "def"}
					var optional *scalar.Token
					if supplied {
						optional = &token
					}
					native := ""
					named := svc.Label("")
					endpoint := func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
						if errorResponse {
							return nil, &svc.Failure{Optional: optional, Required: token, Defaulted: defaulted, Native: &native, Named: &named}
						}
						if location == "projected" {
							return svc.NewViewedRecord(&svc.Record{Optional: optional, Required: token, Defaulted: &defaulted, Native: &native, Named: &native}, "default")
						}
						return &svc.Value{Optional: optional, Required: token, Defaulted: defaulted, Native: &native, Named: &named}, nil
					}
					mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
					server.Mount(mux, server.New(&svc.Endpoints{Header: endpoint, Cookie: endpoint, Projected: endpoint}, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
					w := httptest.NewRecorder()
					mux.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/"+location, nil))
					response := w.Result()
					wantStatus := http.StatusOK
					if errorResponse {
						wantStatus = http.StatusBadRequest
					}
					require.Equal(t, wantStatus, response.StatusCode, w.Body.String())
					values := wireValues(response, location)
					require.Equal(t, "token:abc", values["required"])
					require.Equal(t, "token:def", values["defaulted"])
					require.Contains(t, values, "native")
					require.Contains(t, values, "named")
					if supplied {
						require.Equal(t, "token:abc", values["optional"])
					} else {
						require.NotContains(t, values, "optional")
					}
					value, err := responseDecoder(location)(response)
					if errorResponse {
						var failure *svc.Failure
						require.ErrorAs(t, err, &failure)
						require.Equal(t, token, failure.Required)
						require.Equal(t, optional, failure.Optional)
					} else {
						require.NoError(t, err)
						switch result := value.(type) {
						case *svc.Value:
							require.Equal(t, token, result.Required)
							require.Equal(t, optional, result.Optional)
							require.Equal(t, &native, result.Native)
							require.Equal(t, &named, result.Named)
						case *svc.Record:
							require.Equal(t, token, result.Required)
							require.Equal(t, optional, result.Optional)
						default:
							t.Errorf("unexpected result type %T", value)
						}
					}
					require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
				})
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestCustomResponseTextAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	for _, location := range []string{"header", "cookie"} {
		for _, tc := range []struct {
			name    string
			values  map[string]string
			invalid bool
		}{
			{"absent optional and default", map[string]string{"required": "token:abc"}, false},
			{"valid optional", map[string]string{"required": "token:abc", "optional": "token:xyz"}, false},
			{"missing required", map[string]string{}, true},
			{"empty required", map[string]string{"required": ""}, true},
			{"empty optional", map[string]string{"required": "token:abc", "optional": ""}, true},
			{"invalid custom text", map[string]string{"required": "token:abc", "optional": "invalid"}, true},
			{"raw text constraint", map[string]string{"required": "token:abc", "optional": "token:"}, true},
			{"invalid supplied default", map[string]string{"required": "token:abc", "defaulted": "invalid"}, true},
		} {
			t.Run(location+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				w := httptest.NewRecorder()
				for name, value := range tc.values {
					if location == "cookie" {
						http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: name, Value: value})
					} else {
						w.Header().Set(name, value)
					}
				}
				response := w.Result()
				value, err := responseDecoder(location)(response)
				if tc.invalid {
					require.Error(t, err)
					require.Nil(t, value)
				} else {
					require.NoError(t, err)
					result := value.(*svc.Value)
					require.Equal(t, "token:abc", result.Required.String())
					require.Equal(t, "token:def", result.Defaulted.String())
					if _, present := tc.values["optional"]; present {
						require.Equal(t, "token:xyz", result.Optional.String())
					} else {
						require.Nil(t, result.Optional)
					}
				}
				require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			})
		}
	}
}

func responseDecoder(location string) func(*http.Response) (any, error) {
	switch location {
	case "cookie":
		return client.DecodeCookieResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	case "projected":
		return client.DecodeProjectedResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	default:
		return client.DecodeHeaderResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	}
}

func wireValues(response *http.Response, location string) map[string]string {
	values := map[string]string{}
	if location == "cookie" {
		for _, cookie := range response.Cookies() {
			values[cookie.Name] = cookie.Value
		}
	} else {
		for _, name := range []string{"optional", "required", "defaulted", "native", "named"} {
			if len(response.Header.Values(name)) > 0 {
				values[name] = response.Header.Get(name)
			}
		}
	}
	return values
}

func caseName(errorResponse, supplied bool) string {
	name := "/success"
	if errorResponse {
		name = "/error"
	}
	if supplied {
		return name + "/supplied"
	}
	return name + "/absent"
}
